thuan.noi_dung: Two independent readings point the same way: {nam} is a year to be bolder with what you have already prepared.
thuan.huong_xu_ly: Pick the single biggest task of the year and start early, in the first half of the year.

can_bang.noi_dung: Both readings see {nam} without a big push and without a big stumble. Results come from keeping a steady pace.
can_bang.huong_xu_ly: Set small quarterly milestones and keep them; try anything new on a small scale first.

can_chu_dong.noi_dung: Both readings see {nam} as a year that asks for more care than usual. This is a reminder to plan carefully, not a bad omen.
can_chu_dong.huong_xu_ly: Break big tasks into small steps and keep a back-up plan; check paperwork and money twice before you sign.

khac.tieu_de: {nam}: the two charts see different sides
khac.noi_dung: {mat}. The two methods do not contradict each other — each looks at a different side of the same year, so the level can differ.

huong_xu_ly.can_chu_dong: Use the side that needs care as your safety frame: break big tasks into steps and keep a back-up; use the favourable side for work you have prepared well.
huong_xu_ly.can_bang: Keep a steady pace as your base; save the favourable side for one task you have already prepared, rather than taking on lots of new things.
huong_xu_ly.thuan: Neither method sees a major stumble — choose the most important task and start it early.

mat.tuvi: looks at the areas of your life: work, money, home, relationships
mat.battu: looks at your own strength against the year
mat.thanso: looks at the nine-year rhythm of your numbers
